content: Next.js 16.4 PWA guide (lastUpdated 2026-07-30): app/manifest.ts, manual service worker (push + notificationclick), web-push lib with VAPID keys via 'web-push generate-vapid-keys', Server Actions to store subscriptions; iOS 16.4+ push only for home-screen apps; sw.js headers no-cache + CSP; Serwist only suggested for full offline caching (Turbopack + webpack examples); experimental useOffline hook.
